summary: Measured current production registry deployments, complete-record loading and issuance axes, and authenticated legacy custody recovery on an owned pinned local fork. Recorded 299 signed 32m transactions, four construction receipts for two distinct owners/parents, and 51 admitted operation samples. A real 64-recipient issuance exceeds the target ceiling and rejects before signing or sending. Existing one-recipient operator operations showed no signing/resume mismatch, so production signing policy was not changed.
